_comment: Compressed receipts (tarballs and gzip files) under docs/benchmarks, results, baselines and qrels, reviewed member by member on 2026-11-01 (#221); before then neither receipt guard read inside them. Their bytes are the same at cb8f4665 and at 0e9bf687. Secret review: the member scan in scripts/scan-receipts.sh, with gitleaks 8.21.2, read all 91,481 members (about 8.0 GB, every one UTF-8 text without NUL bytes) and reported 47,569 matches, 9,494 distinct by member and value; none is a credential. 9,491 are its generic-api-key rule on JSON keys that contain "token" or "key": tokenizer names ("cl100k", "approx-chars-div-4"), sha256 memo keys and gpth_ retrieval cache keys in the budgeted-delivery rows, gbrain's random sync-lock UUIDs (token, acquisition_token) in the managed-sync stall samples, and pieces of those values cut at a window edge. One is the token of a 2023 reader.elsevier.com article link that a user pastes in a LongMemEval conversation (2026-10-04-longmemeval-opaque-followups/1a-harness/A2/rows.ndjson.gz), which gitleaks run straight on the extracted members had missed. The other 2 are the jwt.io sample token (HS256, sub 1234567890, name John Doe), which a BEAM conversation quotes as sample code, in the answer and retrieve stages of one wave-2 comparator cell (beam-500k-comparator-rag-13b8f315a8f6, question 1_summarization_0). Machine-path review: 1,807 hold no machine-local path, 125 memory-proof-wave cell tarballs hold only the exempt VM overlay path below, and 63 hold other paths, kept as evidence: sandbox homes (/home/agent, /root, /home/alice-example) and /tmp in Cat 41 and agent-operator session logs, Ubicloud cell stores under /home/ubi/cells and VM /tmp paths in memory-proof-wave receipts, Capy machine paths (/workspace/ in the embedding-matrix receipts and in Cat 41 and agent-operator session logs, ~/.capy/work in the wave-2 re-judge proxy log, /home/user/gbrain@48ed5e82 in an n2-judges capture), and /home/user/Documents paths quoted in benchmark conversations. Each of the 195 tarballs among them lists cleanly with GNU tar 1.35, names no member twice and holds only regular files and directories, so neither guard would refuse it unread. These files stay byte for byte. test/eval/receipt-machine-paths.test.ts reads every other compressed receipt member by member, and scripts/scan-receipts.sh secret-scans it; both skip a file listed here only while its sha256 matches, and the secret scan only while the entry's gitleaks field names the version scripts/scan-receipts.sh pins. An entry without that field records a machine-path review alone, so the secret scan still reads the file. To list a new compressed receipt, review its members the same way and record what they hold.

exempt_machine_paths./home/ubi/work/gbrain-evals/.gbrain-over: The memory-proof-wave harness's overlay checkout on its ephemeral Ubicloud VM. Each ingest stage record in its cell receipts names the gbrain CLI there (gbrain.cli, as <overlay>/<gbrain sha>/src/cli.ts), which identifies the build and no person or reusable machine. Exempt from the machine-path check inside compressed receipts only; scripts/scan-receipts.sh still secret-scans those members.
